pr_body:
Fixes #32212.

Two problems on the light pass when using skeletons, leading to the wrong transform being applied to geometry:

- The texture unit used to bind the bone weights was the same as the light texture.
- The skeleton transform matrices were not being set after binding the lighting shader.

issue_context.title: Light2D doesn't affect Polygon2D when attached to Bone2D
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:** 3.1.1 stable

**OS/device including version:** Windows 10

**Issue description:** light stops casting on a polygon when it's attached to a bone on a skeleton

**Steps to reproduce:** Create a polygon, map the uv points, create a skeleton and bone, attach the polygon to the bone. When they are connected, the light stops casting on the polygon. I followed this guide: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/3.1/tutorials/animation/2d_skeletons.html

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[bugdemoproject.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/3633927/bugdemoproject.zip)

review_comments: Is this necessary if https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/34570 is merged? It looks to me like we would end up setting the same uniform twice.
I was thinking the same, but I believe this is necessary here because these uniforms go to the lighting pass shader. On #34570 they go to the "regular" shader.

The uniforms are set regardless of whether it is a light pass or not here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/drivers/gles3/rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp#L1606

The canvas_shader is not rebound during the light passes so the uniform should still be up to date for each light.
@MadEqua ping. The extra setting of the uniform is unnecessary here, the shader is the same as the uniforms are set immediately above, whether in a light pass or not.

Sorry, this went under my radar.

I might be misunderstanding something but the shader with lighting active is being bound after that, here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/318c69351624f7794c51b5385d252af397c0404a/drivers/gles3/rasterizer_canvas_gles3.cpp#L1677-L1679

and it needs the skeleton transforms to work correctly. That's why the issue still reproduces after merging #34570.
Ah, I missed the ``bind()`` call. Thanks for bearing with me here. Looks good then.
